additional_info.subject: Technical Ticket – Connector 1 Unavailable – Charger R6 No. 313033014001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We experienced an issue with charger SiD (serial number
R6
313033014001), connector 1.
The client reported on July 12th, 2025 at 11:37 PM that the connector was out of service. Following their message, we performed a remote reboot.
The connector status switched back to “available” at 11:46 PM. Status history:
• unavailable from 12/07/2025 11:37:50 to 12/07/2025 23:46:26
• available since 12/07/2025 23:46:26 We have logged the incident internally.
A firmware update (v7.01) is also planned shortly. We kindly ask Siemens to investigate the root cause of this extended unavailability.
Please check if any technical fault or error log was recorded during this period. Charger details:
• Model:  Sicharge D
• Serial number:
R6
313033014001
• Affected connector: No. 1 – CCS DC 160 kW
Looking forward to your feedback,
Best regards,
